items.t: Ignition switch can fail and cut power to accessories
items.job: Replace ignition switch
items.note: Free under recall 96V-017. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag can go off from a static shock
items.job: Install airbag ground wire
items.note: Free under recall 97V-175. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belts may not lock
items.job: Replace rear seat belt assemblies
items.note: Free under recall 97V-115. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front tie rod ends can wear out early
items.job: Replace both outer tie rods and align
items.note: Free under recall 99V-248 / 00V-414. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Throttle can stick open in extreme cold
items.job: Install revised throttle body kit
items.note: Free under recall 04V-495. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel gauge can read full when the tank is not
items.job: Replace fuel level sending units
items.note: Free under recall 01V-157. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Headlight switch wiring can short and overheat
items.job: Repair headlight switch wiring and add jumper harness
items.note: Free under recall 04V-133 / 06V-198. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Instrument cluster center display loses pixels
items.job: Repair or replace instrument cluster display
items.note: Low end is a display-only repair by a cluster specialist; high end is a new cluster.

items.t: Fuel tank vent valve can crack and leak fuel
items.job: Reinforce or repair fuel tank rollover valve
items.note: Free under recall 08V-157 / 11V-267. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump can quit and stall the engine
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel pump
items.note: Free under recall 06V-017 / 07V-375. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Carbon buildup on intake valves causes misfires
items.job: Remove intake manifold and clean intake valves
items.note: Parts are gaskets and seals; cost is mostly labor.

items.t: Power trunk lid can drop shut on its own
items.job: Update trunk lid software; replace struts if weak
items.note: Free under recall 07V-334. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel lines in the engine bay can leak
items.job: Replace engine-bay fuel line, hose or fuel rails
items.note: Free under recall 17V-781 / 16V-646 / 15V-019. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electric coolant pump can overheat and catch fire
items.job: Replace electric auxiliary coolant pump
items.note: Free under recall 18V-229. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front passenger airbag sensor can fail
items.job: Install passenger occupant detection repair kit
items.note: Free under recall 18V-370 / 15V-823. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Auxiliary heater connector can overheat
items.job: Inspect or replace auxiliary heater and connector
items.note: Free under recall 18V-862. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel rails can leak
items.job: Replace both fuel rails
items.note: Free under recall 19V-035. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Mild-hybrid starter generator can short out
items.job: Replace belt starter generator
items.note: Free under recall 20V-153. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Spilled drink in the back seat can shut the car down
items.job: Install protective cover over gateway control module
items.note: Free under recall 22V-861. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel gauge can stick and read wrong
items.job: Replace in-tank fuel level sensor
items.note: Free under recall 22V-155. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear suspension lock nut can break
items.job: Replace rear trailing arm lock nuts and align
items.note: Free under recall 21V-295 / 22V-034. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine computer fault can stall the engine
items.job: Replace engine control unit
items.note: Free under recall 22V-368. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Backup camera image may not appear
items.job: Update infotainment software or replace main unit
items.note: Free under recall 25V-900 / 22V-742 / 22V-806. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Timing chain tensioner and guides can fail
items.job: Replace timing chains, tensioners and guides

items.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires
items.job: Replace ignition coils and spark plugs

items.t: Intake manifold flap motor sticks
items.job: Replace intake manifold flap motor

items.t: Window regulator breaks and the glass drops
items.job: Replace door window regulator

items.t: Side and head airbags may not deploy properly (recall)
items.job: Replace affected side and head airbags
items.note: Free under recall 16V-955. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear seat belt may not lock onto a child seat (recall)
items.job: Replace rear seat belt assemblies
items.note: Free under recall 25V-899. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Water pump and thermostat housing can leak coolant
items.job: Replace water pump and thermostat assembly
items.note: Do the pump and thermostat together; they come apart as one unit on this engine.
